title: Attribute example usefulness through controlled matched swaps

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented native bounded one-example, same-class swaps in the connected examples stage, with fixed rubric/questions/count/order/head during measurement. Matched development scoring records raw decision and final-head metrics, individual question probability shifts, full added/removed example content and explanations. Defaults: 8 swaps and <=200 development items per configuration, cache-aware request preflight, durable resume, retained ideas remeasured with new labels. Prior eligible summaries reach optimizer with development exposure explicitly recorded; changed/repartitioned evidence excluded. Protected audit untouched. Existing initial seeding and downstream fitter/promotion safeguards remain. No live model calls were made for this implementation.
